desc: 整箱主图到场景背书的粉调气泡水套组，主张与证据位全占位
name: 无糖果味气泡水畅饮款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼点开，用整箱托盘加单瓶并列建立家庭装的量感与主体形态。
一秒法则传递首要购买理由，用斜放瓶身和右侧大块留白承接主张与佐证。
shots.textZone: 右侧 40% 留白承接一条主张与一句佐证

shots.intent: 用瓶壁冷凝水珠的微距质感证明冰镇清爽，替下任何口感文字主张。
把饮品放进真实的佐餐与桌面时刻，让买家自我代入并完成解渴想象。
承接源图的信息面板结构，用空白参数行把成分与规格证据位交给后期真实数据。
shots.textZone: 中部面板仅空白参数行与空白数值列，供后期填真实数据

shots.intent: 消除决策风险，用线性图标与空印章框搭出背书栏骨架，真实资质后期再填。
shots.textZone: 右侧图标下方三行短标签位，仅放占位符

shots.intent: 把同一饮品按不同包装形态与饮用时刻并列，让买家自选规格并抬升客单。
shots.textZone: 顶部三等分标签位，各放一条场景主张占位符

shots.intent: 收口促单，用仰视瓶身压住品牌色底，把主张与行动按钮位一次性交代清楚。
shots.textZone: 右上两条堆叠主张占位符，底部一枚按钮位

style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for the packshot, flat glossy pink #F2A3C0 panels for every graphic shot, deep crimson #A8122C and dark plum #3D1B45 fields for the macro, scene and close, each graphic panel finished with a thin crimson and plum footer stripe
style.direction: playful premium flavored sparkling water ecommerce
style.iconSystem: flat single-color thin-line pictograms plus empty shield and seal outlines, one glyph per idea, no shading, no embedded marks
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key neutral studio light with a front-left key and soft fill, crisp specular streak on the chilled bottle wall, fine condensation, soft contact shadow only, no harsh cast shadow
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent playful-premium flavored sparkling water ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white #FFFFFF, glossy pink #F2A3C0, deep crimson #A8122C and dark plum #3D1B45; bright even high-key neutral studio lighting with a front-left key and soft fill, crisp specular streak on the chilled bottle and soft contact shadows; seamless flat color panels finished with a thin crimson and plum footer stripe; one bold condensed geometric sans-serif for headlines paired with one lighter companion sans, never mixed with other families; flat single-color thin-line pictograms and empty badge outlines only; stable bottle scale and label-forward placement across all shots; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented numbers or badges.
noDrift: no invented numbers, percentages or badges
style.presentationRules: the bottle keeps a stable upright or boldly diagonal stance at consistent scale, the label field stays an untouched blank plane, berries and ice appear only as corner garnish and never cover the label
style.surfaceSystem: white seamless sweep for packshots, glossy pink acrylic sheet dotted with water droplets for graphic shots, dark plum matte slate for the scene
style.typography: one bold condensed geometric sans-serif for headlines plus one lighter companion sans for short proof lines, in-image copy always carried as placeholder tokens, never source sentences
